context: Ren reports operational steps to Hiroshi-boss.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: business report; operations vocabulary (行う/実施/施設/作成/等) in natural home.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 点検は、来週に実施いたします。
lines.en: We'll carry out the inspection next week.
lines.style: measured young presenter voice, soft warm professional focus throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: どの施設から、行うのかね?
lines.en: Which facility do we start with?
lines.style: attentive boss voice, soft warm inquiry throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本社の施設から、順に行います。
lines.en: We'll proceed in order from the headquarters facility.
lines.style: precise young presenter voice, soft warm professional focus throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 報告書等は、誰が作成するのかね?
lines.en: Who creates the reports and such?
lines.style: engaged boss voice, soft warm inquiry throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 担当者が、書類等を作成します。
lines.en: The person in charge creates the documents and so on.
lines.style: measured young presenter voice, soft warm professional focus throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 実施の前に、確認を行ってくれ。
lines.en: Carry out a check before implementation.
lines.style: firm boss voice, soft warm inquiry throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 各施設で、事前確認を行います。
lines.en: We'll do prior checks at each facility.
lines.style: confident young presenter voice, soft warm resolved throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 計画通り、実施してくれたまえ。
lines.style: satisfied boss voice, soft warm decisive closing throughout
